_comment: Single source of truth for what YazSes puts on the Hugging Face Hub. Read by scripts/hf_preflight.py, scripts/hf_collection.py and .github/workflows/huggingface-publish.yml. Only the files listed under each destination are ever uploaded. owner_approved stays false until the owner flips it in a reviewed commit; a destination whose repo does not exist yet stays status=planned.

collection.title: YazSes — Offline Speech Recognition Research
collection.description: Offline, privacy-first voice dictation: the YazSes paper, demo, benchmark data and the Whisper models it runs on.

items.note: YazSes: An Offline, Privacy-First, Cross-Platform Hold-to-Talk Voice-Dictation System (arXiv, 2026-07-30). Planned: the Hub returned 404 for hf.co/papers/2607.28878 on 2026-10-27, i.e. the paper page is not indexed yet.
